# Edit a todo

## Add a todo
Type "Buy milk" into the "What needs to be done?" input and press Enter.
Verify the todo list shows "Buy milk".

## Edit the todo by double-clicking it
Double-click the "Buy milk" todo text to enter edit mode.
Clear the edit field, type "Buy oat milk" and press Enter.
Verify the todo list shows "Buy oat milk" and no longer shows "Buy milk".
Verify the footer item counter reads "1 item left".

----- end -----

Rules:
- Only append. Do not modify, reorder, weaken or delete any existing line (Kane re-records every step after an edit, so editing earlier steps is expensive and is rejected).
- The new step must PASS on the real app and FAIL on the broken app described above.
- Use exact expected values a user would see (amounts with currency symbol, item names, counts, status words).
- Do not mention bugs, mutants or Tripwire in the test, and never name the broken value
  (the wrong number, the extra record): assert the correct state, so the check stays general.

Assertion patterns that worked before in this repo:
- The test checks which rows are listed, or how many (caught: rendered-item-drop; I added a final step that tells Kane not to add, edit or re-enter any todo, then checks that the list shows exactly 3 visible rows and that the first one reads )
